component_domain_selections.geom1_breast_union_dom: Final union of adipose, glandular, and chest-wall domains
component_domain_selections.geom1_adipose_diff_dom: Adipose region after subtracting glandular volume from outer breast
component_domain_selections.geom1_gland_clip_dom: Glandular ellipsoid clipped to the outer breast

component_boundary_selections.geom1_breast_union_bnd: Exterior boundaries of the full assembled breast/chest geometry
component_boundary_selections.geom1_breast_outer_bnd: Outer breast envelope boundary; used as the current skin-shell carrier boundary
component_boundary_selections.geom1_chest_cyl_bnd: Boundaries of the chest-wall support domain

geometry_feature_tags.breast_outer: Outer breast envelope with FEBio-style baseline and optional light thorax curvature
geometry_feature_tags.gland_keep_anterior: Anterior keep region used to clip the glandular ellipsoid at the chest wall
geometry_feature_tags.gland_clip: Glandular source volume clipped to the breast outer volume
geometry_feature_tags.gland_lobules: Union of COMSOL-native lobule ellipsoids derived from the exported FEBio lobule layout
geometry_feature_tags.adipose_diff: Adipose outer volume minus glandular volume
geometry_feature_tags.chest_cyl: Chest-wall support body; cylindrical in baseline mode, lightly curved in curved mode

notes: The shell scaffold is generated defensively because COMSOL API identifiers can vary by version/license.
The Solid-Thin Structure Connection is emitted as a scaffold on the same outer boundary selection and may need manual refinement in COMSOL.
Curved mode replaces the flat posterior clip plane with a shallow cylindrical arc in the yz side-view, so the chest wall reads as a ')' style curve.
The chest-wall support domain reuses that same interface so the breast and chest wall remain conformal.

linearized_material_inference.note: Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio are inferred from FEBio Mooney-Rivlin inputs for an initial small-strain COMSOL model.
